data.description: Once per day, before making a Diplomacy or Sense Motive check, the wearer can roll twice and take the better result. The wearer can adjust a creature's attitude up to three steps when using Diplomacy. However,should the wearer ever fail a Diplomacy check to adjust a creature's attitude by 5 or more, the creature's attitude is reduced by two steps instead of one.
